## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%) while XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) and VXX ↑ (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.55%) provide two independent confirmations of money rotating away from narrow tech leadership into energy/defensive pockets.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Reflation tilt: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +9.47%) → commodity bid (CPER/GLD ↑ rising). Volatility creeping up: VXX ↑ (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.55%) ABOVE TREND. Credit signals mixed: HYG (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +0.10%) vs LQD (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +1.30%) → HYG/LQD broadly flat.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-slightly-easing: TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +4.07%) ↑ rising while SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -1.36%) → SPY/TLT flat BELOW TREND; Dollar UUP CORRECTION (1W: -0.04% | 1M: +1.69%) shows limited dollar support.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Utilities/Staples and Energy leading: XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%), XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +9.34%), XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%). Tech weakness persists: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%). Style: mixed — defensive + cyclical pockets outperform, no clean growth leadership.

5. US vs Global?
Selective global strength: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.38% | 1M: +3.01%) and EWJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +8.40%) while FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -7.95%). SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -1.36%) — US not uniformly outperforming.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed and cautious: ARKK RECOVERY (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -7.64%), IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -0.72%), IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -26.37%) — retail/speculative risk is retreating.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Commodity reflation visible: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +9.47%) with GLD RECOVERY (1W: +3.23% | 1M: -2.19%) — cyclical commodity bid coexisting with gold strength.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy broadly strong: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +9.47%); nat gas weak: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -20.72%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +4.07%) and XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%). Divergence: multiple sector corrections (XLI CORRECTION (1W: -0.05% | 1M: +7.92%), various small-cap corrections) represent minor-to-moderate dispersion, not a broad trend reversal.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor rotation into energy and defensive income exposure (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%), XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%)); reduce exposure to tech beta (XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%)) and highly speculative crypto (IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -26.37%)); bonds remain a ballast (TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +4.07%)).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Energy — XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) if oil (BNO) keeps strength. BULLISH: Utilities/Staples — XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%), XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +9.34%) on defensive flows. BEARISH: Technology — XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%) if earnings/momentum continue to disappoint.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Brent/energy — BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +9.47%) on reflation. BEARISH: Natural gas — UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -20.72%) and sensitive to warm weather.

13. Key Levels?
VIX ~29 (VIX Level: 28.90 | 1W: -1.83% | 1M: +6.13%) for risk sentiment, HYG/LQD credit spread ~0.72 (Credit Spread Level: 0.7228 | 1W: -0.16% | 1M: -1.15%) for credit health, Tech vs Financials 2.70 (Tech vs Financials Level: 2.6980 | 1W: -1.19% | 1M: -1.63%) as the growth/value pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, with energy (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%)) and defensives (XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%)) showing strength. Key risk: tech weakness (XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%)) and rising volatility (VXX ↑ (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.55%)) that could widen sector dispersion.
